comment: * Interface that defines the core validation mechanism when accessing zip file entry paths.

methods.name: void onZipEntryAccess(@NonNull String path) throws ZipException
methods.comment:
* Called to check the validity of the path of a zip entry. The default implementation * accepts all paths without raising any exceptions. *

* This method will be called by {@link java.util.zip.ZipInputStream#getNextEntry} or * {@link java.util.zip.ZipFile#ZipFile(String)}. * * @param path The name of the zip entry. * @throws ZipException If the zip entry is invalid depending on the implementation.

methodNames: void onZipEntryAccess(@NonNull String path) throws ZipException
